checks.text: The page shows the heading "Quiz App" and the tab labels "Questions" and "Study".

On the "Questions" tab, typing "What is 2+2?" in the field labelled "Question", selecting "Multiple choice" in the select labelled "Type", typing "4" in the first option field labelled "Option A", typing "3" in "Option B", typing "5" in "Option C", typing "6" in "Option D", selecting "A" in the select labelled "Correct answer" and clicking "Save question" adds a list item containing "What is 2+2?" and "Multiple choice".
After adding the question from A2, clicking the "Study" tab shows the text "1 question ready" and a button labelled "Start session".
On the "Study" tab, clicking "Start session" shows the question text "What is 2+2?", four option buttons labelled "A: 4", "B: 3", "C: 5", "D: 6", and a button labelled "Next".
Clicking the option button "B: 3" shows the feedback text "Incorrect" and the correct answer "A: 4".
After answering the question from A5, clicking "Next" shows the session summary with the text "Score: 0/1" and a button labelled "Review mistakes".
Clicking "Review mistakes" shows a list containing the question "What is 2+2?" and the text "Your answer: B: 3".
On the "Questions" tab, clicking the button "Delete What is 2+2?" removes the question from the list and shows the text "No questions yet".
Reload keeps the question "What is 2+2?" in the list on the "Questions" tab.
